title: Show My Labs in the signed-in account menu
description: Add a signed-in account-menu destination labeled **My Labs** that navigates to `/labs`, alongside the existing personal destinations such as logout and the user’s tracks. Move the current Listening Room route from `/listen` to `/labs`, updating internal navigation, route tests, and any user-facing references. The destination should be visible only when authenticated and use existing menu/link conventions. This does not change ListeningCycle or Lab behavior.
